Six years ago, Hakeem Jeffries stood before the United States Senate, making the case for Donald Trump’s impeachment. Now he is set to occupy one of the most powerful positions in the country’s political system as the Speaker of the House of Representatives amid a Republican rout in the 2026 US midterm elections. Debdutta Chakraborty brings details on how the next US congress speaker is.
